CAT_1_UNRESOLVED_LOCAL_SYMBOL.description: <use href='#symbol_id'> points to a <symbol> not present in the static element list or domMap.
CAT_1_UNRESOLVED_LOCAL_SYMBOL.failureMechanism: Without document-wide DOM graph traversal or symbol map registration, the detector cannot inspect the referenced <symbol> element's child <title> or <desc>.
CAT_1_UNRESOLVED_LOCAL_SYMBOL.remediation: Implement SvgSemanticResolver with domMap symbol registry lookup and explicit AMBIGUOUS_ABSTAIN state when symbol ID is unresolvable locally.

CAT_2_UNHANDLED_TITLE_ATTRIBUTE_PROPERTY.description: SVG element possesses title property on ElementRepresentation but not in attributes dictionary.
CAT_2_UNHANDLED_TITLE_ATTRIBUTE_PROPERTY.failureMechanism: AccessibleNameComputer checked attrs['title'] but bypassed element.title property.
CAT_2_UNHANDLED_TITLE_ATTRIBUTE_PROPERTY.remediation: Consolidate title attribute resolution across element.attributes['title'] and element.title property.

CAT_3_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_AMBIGUITY.failureMechanism: Security invariant strictly forbids fetching remote network URLs.
CAT_3_EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_AMBIGUITY.remediation: Flag external URL references as AMBIGUOUS_ABSTAIN with zero network requests.
